import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])

    invs = [0] * (2 * n + 3)
    invs[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, len(invs)):
        invs[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * invs[MOD % i] % MOD

    p = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(2 * n + 1)]
    p[0][1] = 1

    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        prev_max_running = min(2 * n - i, i)
        max_running = min(2 * n - i - 1, i + 1)
        for j in range(prev_max_running + 1):
            val = p[i - 1][j]
            if val != 0:
                if j > 0:
                    p[i][j - 1] = (p[i][j - 1] + val * j % MOD * invs[2 * n - i] % MOD) % MOD
                if j < max_running:
                    p[i][j + 1] = (p[i][j + 1] + val * (2 * n - i - j) % MOD * invs[2 * n - i] % MOD) % MOD

    ans = 0
    for i in range(2 * n):
        for j in range(k, n + 1):
            if p[i][j] != 0:
                ans = (ans + p[i][j]) % MOD

    ans = ans * l % MOD * invs[2 * n + 1] % MOD
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
